from z3 import *

def solve():
    V = 16
    E = [[Bool(f"e_{i}_{j}") if i < j else False for j in range(V)] for i in range(V)]
    for i in range(V):
        for j in range(i):
            E[i][j] = E[j][i]
            
    s = Solver()
    
    # At least 23 edges
    edge_vars = [E[i][j] for i in range(V) for j in range(i+1, V)]
    s.add(Sum([If(e, 1, 0) for e in edge_vars]) >= 23)
    
    # 3-colorable
    C = [Int(f"c_{i}") for i in range(V)]
    for i in range(V):
        s.add(C[i] >= 0, C[i] <= 2)
    for i in range(V):
        for j in range(i+1, V):
            s.add(Implies(E[i][j], C[i] != C[j]))
            
    # Girth >= 7 (no cycles of length 3, 4, 5, 6)
    # Length 3
    for i in range(V):
        for j in range(i+1, V):
            for k in range(j+1, V):
                s.add(Not(And(E[i][j], E[j][k], E[k][i])))
                
    # Length 4
    for i in range(V):
        for j in range(i+1, V):
            for k in range(j+1, V):
                for l in range(k+1, V):
                    # Any 4 vertices can form 3 different 4-cycles
                    s.add(Not(And(E[i][j], E[j][k], E[k][l], E[l][i])))
                    s.add(Not(And(E[i][j], E[j][l], E[l][k], E[k][i])))
                    s.add(Not(And(E[i][k], E[k][j], E[j][l], E[l][i])))
                    
    # Length 5
    import itertools
    for p in itertools.combinations(range(V), 5):

    # Enumerating cycles of length 6: 16 choose 6 = 8008. For each, 60 cycles. 480480 clauses.
